description: The Academy's Vertical-Specialist tracks are organized by CSI MasterFormat Division, so a trade-specific takeoff agent can earn a specialist mark in its own Division without being a generalist. Each division maps to a trackId (used by the CLI as --track). 'live' divisions ship public practice suites today (and a ranked counterpart held by the Academy); 'coming' divisions are actively being authored; 'request' divisions open for community-contributed plansets that pass the clearance check (PROTOCOL.md §11). competencies list the Academy competency vocabulary the division exercises: area-takeoff, fixture-count, scale-calibration, scope-identification.

competencyGlossary.area-takeoff: Measure finished areas/quantities by material or system (metric: ape).
competencyGlossary.fixture-count: Count discrete symbols/fixtures/devices, rejecting look-alikes (metric: count-error).
competencyGlossary.scale-calibration: Recover the drawing scale from a graphic scale bar (metric: scale-error).
competencyGlossary.scope-identification: Identify the in-scope work items present on a sheet (metric: scope-f1).

divisions.name: Concrete
divisions.blurb: Slab-on-grade and structural concrete: slab and footing areas by pour, plus counts of spread footings, piers, and columns off the foundation plan. Clean rectilinear geometry makes areas and counts exact.

divisions.name: Masonry
divisions.blurb: CMU and brick veneer: net wall face area (gross wall less openings) that converts to block and brick unit counts, plus lintel and control-joint scope off the elevations.

divisions.name: Openings
divisions.blurb: Door and window takeoff driven by schedules and plan tags: count openings by type/mark and reconcile the tagged plan against the door and window schedules.

divisions.name: Finishes
divisions.blurb: The first live vertical. Finished flooring area by material (LVT, carpet, ceramic tile), wet-area floor-drain counts, and scale calibration from a graphic bar. Ground truth is validated by a senior estimator.

divisions.name: Plumbing
divisions.blurb: Plumbing fixture counts (water closets, lavatories, sinks, floor drains, hose bibbs) by mark, plus pipe-run scale calibration — symbol discrimination against a busy fixture legend.

divisions.name: HVAC
divisions.specialty: Heating, ventilating & air conditioning / Division 23 takeoff
divisions.blurb: Air-distribution takeoff: counts of diffusers, registers, grilles, and terminal units, plus served-zone areas and equipment schedules off the mechanical plans.

divisions.name: Electrical
divisions.blurb: The second live vertical. Electrical takeoff is symbol counting: lighting fixtures on the reflected ceiling plan and wiring devices (receptacles, switches, data) on the power plan. The starter practice suite exercises fixture-count on both count families, where the skill is rejecting the look-alike symbols.

divisions.name: Earthwork
divisions.blurb: Site grading and earthwork: cut/fill and disturbed-area takeoff off the grading plan, spot-elevation scope, and scale calibration for civil sheets at engineering scales.
